notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Any creature type besides "Spirit" chosen with Conspiracy.
description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing any other creature you control.
The creature dies, triggering Requiem Angel, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
